inheritance: Every domain receives all universal circumference dimensions; entries below define domain-specific emphasis only.

semantic_rule.swirm: Capabilities that perform the same functional contract or belong to the same tightly bounded function family are grouped into a SWIRM so ABBA can compare and substitute implementations.
semantic_rule.team: Capabilities from different SWIRMs are composed into a TEAM when a real intent/mission requires them to function together.
semantic_rule.domain: Domains describe the full real-world field; products are projections into domains.
semantic_rule.no_duplicate_function: Crossing domains does not justify duplicating a shared function; resolve it to the same canonical capability family/SWIRM.

input-output.domain: I/O — Input, Output, Movement, Access and Flow
